page.layout: One page of text in a single column of dictionary entries, with Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldean words set in Hebrew-script type inline. No margin notes. Page number top left, running head top centre. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: אורָעָא Ch. & Syr. Occursus, Prov.7.15. Matth.8.34. Act.28.15. לאורָעָא In occursum, obviam.
אורעות, אורָעָא Ch.Occursus: Casus, Eventus, Accidens.
מאָרַע Ch.Occursus, Jobi 7.20. Convocatio, Levit.23.3. in Jonath. Plur. cost. מְאָרְעֵי Covocationes, Ibid.v.2.
ארע, אַרְעָא Ch.& Syr. Terra. Ab Hebreo ארץ, comutato ז in y, quod in hac lingua frequens. Plural. ארעתא, ארעין Terrae, Regiones.
ארעאי, ארעאה Ch. Imum, Infimum, inferius. Plural. מדורין ארעאין Habitationes inferiores, Genes.6.16.
Syr. Terrestris, Terrenus. Plur. Ʃ 1. ad Corinth.15.40. Fœmin. Terrena, Jacob.3.15.
אורעיתא Ch.Aspis: Crabro. Plur. אורעיתא Deuter.1.44. &7.20. in Jon. Hebr. צרעה. Et masc. אורעי Levit.11.20.in Jon. ubi in Venetis male scribitur per ד.
ארק ארקא Ch. Terra, Jerem.10.11. Idem quod ארעא: y enim & p quandoque inter se permutari solent.
ארקלין Esth.1.3.in Targ.sec. Elias & Guido scribunt se ignorare quid significet. Est vox peregrina & corrupta. Videtur significare Cannabim.
אשתא, אשא, ואש Chald. & Syr. Ignis:

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldean words are transcribed approximately; the vowel points and Syriac letters are not fully reliable. The Syriac/Hebrew forms on the line "Syr. Terrestris" and "Fœmin." are shown as a dotted Syriac script and could not be reproduced exactly; the last line of the page ends with a Chaldean word and a printed letter F below it, which is a catchword-like mark and is not transcribed as text.
